about_the_game:
Overview:
Fight'N'Jokes: Storylines Demo lets you step into the weird and wonderful world of Miopinja, a teenage ninja from a clan of fish warriors.
This early slice of gameplay offers a chance to explore, interact, laugh, and chase chickens through a colorful and chaotic world packed with oddball characters and unexpected quests.

Demo Details:
This demo represents roughly a quarter of Chapter 1 and takes about 30 minutes to complete (or faster if you speed through!).
You’ll be able to complete most quests, explore the grandfather’s house and village, and preview action-lite sequences like Quick Time Events and the chaotic chicken-chasing quest.
One quest (Bolo’s) remains unresolved in the demo and will be fully available in the final game.

We recommend players talk to as many characters and interact with as many objects as possible, you never know what you'll find!

Key Features:

  • 🌟 Explore a charming and absurd fish-ninja world

  • 🧩 Solve playful puzzles and complete quirky quests

  • 🐔 Experience action-lite sequences like chicken chasing and quick-time events

  • 🎭 Meet eccentric NPCs with unique dialogue and personalities

  • 🏠 Discover secrets hidden throughout the grandfather's house and village

  • 😂 Enjoy a heartfelt, humor-driven adventure where jokes are just as important as missions

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or Higher (64-bit)
  • Processor: 2.8GHz Quad Core CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Higher (64-bit)
  • Processor: 3.2GHz Quad Core CPU
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: A quirky 3D action-lite, story-driven adventure where you explore, interact, solve puzzles, and complete silly quests. Joke, chase, and uncover secrets in a vibrant world full of oddball characters and absurd situations.
supported_languages:
English*, Italian, German, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian
*languages with full audio support
